name: workspace-check-compile-preflight
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p core/agent-consult/tsconfig.json --noEmit > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1

name: workspace-check-focused-native
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun test core/agent-consult/workspace.test.ts core/agent-consult.test.ts research/agent-tools/protocol.test.ts research/agent-tools/service.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1

name: workspace-check-built-node-demo
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; python3 --version > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/python.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/build.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/build.log" 2>&1; node scripts/agent-consult-workspace-demo.mjs > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/workspace-check-transcript.jsonl" 2> "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/demo.stderr.log"
